youtube.title: Credit Card 'Minimum Due': The Costliest Button #Shorts
youtube.description:
Why paying only the credit card minimum amount due is so expensive in India. Most cards charge finance charges of up to 3.75% a month (about 45% a year). Owe ₹1 lakh, pay only a 5% minimum each month, and after 12 months you've paid about ₹56,000 but still owe about ₹86,000.

Numbers in this video:
• Card finance charges up to 3.75% a month / 45% a year: ICICI Bank credit card interest-rate page; SBI Card, HDFC Bank and Axis Bank list up to 3.75% a month (Paisabazaar rate table, 2026)
• 12-month example: ₹1,00,000 balance, 3.75% monthly interest, 5% minimum paid each month (illustrative; GST on interest and fees make it worse; terms vary by bank)
• Carrying a balance usually removes the interest-free period on new purchases (see your card's MITC)

Do you pay the total due every month? Comment below.
